name: Caretaker's Talent
description: Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn. {W}: Level 2 — When this Class becomes level 2, create a token that's a copy of target token you control. {3}{W}: Level 3 — Creature tokens you control get +2/+2.
assumptions: Presented using the standard Class-enchantment layout (base ability, then Level 2/3 headers each followed by their effect).
Assumed real-world Class rule that levels must be gained in order, since the flow graph itself doesn't encode a dependency between the two `becomes` roots.
couldNotDerive: The Level 2 effect (create a token copy of target token) — Forge's DB$ CopyPermanent has no translator support at all, so the trigger it's chained to has zero outgoing steps in the packet.
notes: Level 3's anthem (+2/+2 to creature tokens) reconstructed correctly — confirms the AddStaticAbility$ fix from attempt 1 is working. Two gaps remain, both real: (1) ActivationLimit$1 ("This ability triggers only once each turn") had no flag at all — fixed by adding cond:once_per_turn to the trigger-node builder, verified in isolation via forgeTranslate.test.ts (all 11 pass) since a 3rd live exam wasn't run for budget reasons. (2) DB$ CopyPermanent (Level 2's "create a token that's a copy of target token you control") is a genuinely unimplemented effect type — left as an open unmapped gap (`?:CopyPermanent` in the translator's unmapped list) rather than implemented now; it's a new effect shape (not a quick field/regex fix like the others this batch), but also not architecturally blocking like Beza's dynamic-comparison gap — a real backlog item, not a design decision needed before proceeding.
